name: Linkding
longDescription:
Linkding is a bookmark manager designed to be minimal, fast and easy to set up. It offers a clean interface, tags, full-text search, bulk editing, read-it-later, automatic titles and descriptions, archiving on the Internet Archive, import and export in Netscape format, browser extensions for Firefox and Chrome, a REST API and multi-user support with bookmark sharing.

This app uses the built-in SQLite database. An admin account is created on first start with a generated password, shown at the end of the installation.
description: A minimal, fast bookmark manager with tags, search, browser extensions and a REST API
